theme_and_archetype.archetype: Hybrid: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) + Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) + Scandinavian Minimalism
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Balances the trust and warmth required by parents with the playful, engaging energy of a premium early childhood center. Minimalist white-space allows the custom pastel/vibrant brand colors to pop without overwhelming.

colors.usage_rules: Use background_cream as the main page canvas. Use light_surface for secondary sections (like footer or alternating bands). Use the 4 primary colors strictly as accents for buttons, badges, icons, and decorative organic blobs. Dark text for all typography.

rules.h1: font-poppins text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1F1F1F]
rules.h2: font-poppins text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1F1F1F]
rules.labels: font-dm-sans text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[#FF6B2C]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Container padding px-6 md:px-12.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Maximum roundness. Use rounded-3xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons and badges. Use custom organic blob borders for hero images: rounded-[40%_60%_70%_30%/40%_50%_60%_50%] or similar.
layout_and_spacing.icons: Use lucide-react with strokeWidth={2.5} for a slightly chunkier, friendlier feel.

components_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses one of the brand colors (e.g., #FF6B2C) with #FFFFFF text. Hover state: slight scale (scale-105) and shadow-lg. Secondary buttons use transparent bg with solid border or light_surface.
components_instructions.cards: bg-white, rounded-3xl, soft shadow, p-8. Add 1px border of #F1F1F1 for crispness. Hover: translate-y-[-4px].
components_instructions.forms: Inputs should have rounded-2xl, bg-white, 1px border border-[#F1F1F1], p-4, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#60A5FA] focus:outline-none.
components_instructions.badges: rounded-full px-4 py-1 text-sm font-semibold. Background should be a 10-15% opacity tint of a primary color with solid text color.

sections.name: Header
sections.design: Sticky top, z-50. Starts transparent, transitions to bg-[#FFF7EE]/90 backdrop-blur-md on scroll. Logo on left, nav links center (DM Sans, font-medium), CTA button right (Pill, Primary Orange). Border bottom ONLY when scrolled.

sections.name: Hero
sections.design: Headline 'Where little minds grow through play, care, and confidence.' (Poppins). Layout: 2-column. Text left, layered images right. Images should be masked in organic blob shapes or heavily rounded frames, slightly overlapping. Decorate background with subtle floating SVG squiggles or circles in the 4 primary colors. Dual CTAs: solid orange and outline text.

sections.name: Why Families Choose Us
sections.design: 4 feature cards. Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Each card features a top icon with a soft background matching one of the 4 primary colors, rounded-3xl, soft shadow. Title and short description.

sections.name: Programs
sections.design: 4 cards (Infant, Toddler, Preschool, After School). Large image at top (rounded-t-3xl or inner rounded-2xl), age range badge overlapping image, title, and description. Hover: Image slight scale up.

sections.name: Environment (Split Editorial)
sections.design: 50/50 split. Left side: large breathtaking image of Scandinavian classroom. Right side: Generous whitespace, typography-driven text about natural materials and calm spaces. Use decorative blob background element behind the image.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.design: Full width section with bg-white. Cards on a light surface or masonry grid of review cards. Quote icon in Primary Yellow.

sections.name: Gallery Preview
sections.design: Bento-style image grid for gallery with heavy border radius (rounded-3xl).

sections.name: Call to Action
sections.design: Massive, centered section: 'Ready to take the next step?' with dual buttons. Add playful abstract shapes floating around.

sections.name: Footer
sections.design: bg-[#1F1F1F] text-[#F1F1F1] or use #F1F1F1 with dark text. The layout asks for minimal premium: Logo, Nav, Contact, Inquiry button, Newsletter signup. Input for newsletter must be rounded-full with an inline button.

sections.name: Enrollment Inquiry Modal/Form
sections.design: Clean dialog/modal overlay (Shadcn Dialog). Use generous padding, rounded-3xl. Form fields for Parent Name, Child Age, Program Interest, Email. Connected to backend.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI strictly following the design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, radii) provided in this document.
Implement a working backend using FastAPI for the Newsletter signup and Enrollment inquiry forms. Forms should submit data to these endpoints and handle success/error states gracefully.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Do NOT use placeholder text or dummy image URLs. ONLY use the image URLs provided in this JSON.
Use Lucide React for icons, keeping them child-friendly by setting strokeWidth to 2.5.
Ensure Tailwind config is updated with the custom colors (primary_orange, etc.) and fonts (Poppins, DM Sans). Add Google Fonts links for Poppins and DM Sans in index.html.
Implement the sticky navbar logic with framer-motion or standard React state for transparent-to-blur transitions.
